tabs.one: Google warns of autonomous AI cyberattacks , while Tata Steel restructures with a ₹28,000 crore stake buy in APL Apollo  and India's crypto industry seeks Budget tax relief .
tabs.html:
The big stories

  • Autonomous AI Cyber Threats: Google warns that hackers are increasingly deploying AI agents to find software vulnerabilities and execute attacks with minimal human intervention .
  • Tata Steel Restructuring: Tata Steel announces plans to acquire a 26.38% controlling stake in APL Apollo Tubes for ₹28,000 crore to consolidate its downstream steel and tube business .
  • Meta Protests in India: Telangana Youth Congress workers and Delhi protesters stormed Meta offices, demanding the restoration of blocked accounts belonging to party leaders .
  • Crypto Industry Tax Lobbying:Ahead of Budget 2027, the Bharat Web3 Association (BWA) has urged the Indian government to review the 30% tax on virtual digital assets and reduce the 1% TDS .
  • FSSAI Crackdown on Bisleri: India’s food safety regulator has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International after a regulatory sample of its packaged drinking water failed safety tests .

Launches & products

  • Honor 700 Series: Launched with a rear "Floating Island" secondary display, a massive 9,000mAh battery, and a 200MP camera .
  • Ulefone Armor 35 Pro: Rugged smartphone featuring a 1.2 km laser rangefinder and an 11,000mAh battery, launching December 7 for $430 .
  • Motorola Edge 70 Neo: India launch scheduled for November 24, packing a 7,000mAh battery, AMOLED display, and Snapdragon processor .
  • RingConn "The One Ring": Released a Lord of the Rings-themed version of its Gen 3 smart ring featuring Elvish script, health tracking, and haptic alerts .

The market angle

  • Reliance Retail (Reliance Industries): A Haryana consumer commission penalized Reliance Retail and Reliance Smart Superstore ₹7,500 for crediting a Re 1 refund into a JioMart digital wallet without explicit user consent .
  • Xiaomi / Redmi: Xiaomi raised prices on several REDMI Book and REDMI Book Pro laptops in China by CNY 300 to CNY 500 (~$40 to $70) due to component cost shifts .
  • Samsung: Reports indicate Samsung may skip annual releases and move the Galaxy Watch to a two-year launch cycle starting in 2027 , alongside expected price hikes for the Galaxy S27 series driven by surging memory costs .

Worth reading

  • Europe’s Cloud Sovereignty: An in-depth look at how Europe's cloud push is gaining ground even as US hyperscalers maintain market dominance .
  • Anthropic’s Backers: Notable Capital, GIC, and Baillie Gifford share the convictions that drove their massive pre-IPO bets on Anthropic .

tabs.one: Record festive retail sales led by a 52.6% surge in EVs contrast with a NITI Aayog report showing auto PLI incremental sales lagging at 23% of targets.
tabs.html:
The big stories

  • India's automobile retail sales hit a record 55.25 lakh units during the 42-day festive period, with electric vehicles crossing 5 lakh units, growing over 52% YoY 320.
  • Electric two-wheelers drove festive momentum, surging 61.1% to 3.31 lakh units and accounting for over 82% of total two-wheeler volume gains 2426.
  • Passenger vehicles were the only major category to register a year-on-year decline during the festive season 20.
  • A NITI Aayog report on the Auto PLI scheme revealed that while investments surpassed targets at 104%, incremental sales reached only 23% and employment hit 46%, heavily constrained by strict localization and compliance hurdles .
  • Ambit Capital released top auto stock picks, highlighting healthy OEM order books, low channel inventory, and better-than-expected average selling price growth in Q2 39.

Launches & products

  • Triumph Street Triple 798 RS: Launched at Rs 14.39 lakh, positioned above the 765 RS as the brand's lightest Street Triple ever 18.
  • Ultraviolette X47 Venom: Electric motorcycle deliveries began across India, featuring an 11 kWh battery, 343 km range, and 30 kW power 17.
  • Bajaj Pulsar RS200: Updated with slightly more power and new features at Rs 1,98,441 25.
  • Suzuki Access 125: Introduced two new color options—Metallic Royal Bronze and Metallic Mat Bordeaux Red—with prices starting at Rs 83,086 .
  • Tata Punch Flex Fuel: Spied testing near Pune, hinting at a potential debut at the Bharat Expo 2027 29.

The market angle

  • Hero MotoCorp (HEROMOTOCO): Increased prices across the high-volume Splendor range by up to Rs 3,000 in November 2026 30.
  • Greaves Cotton (GREABASE): Ampere recorded 7,956 electric two-wheeler registrations in November 2026, capturing a 6% market share and solidifying a Top 5 position 28.
  • JSW MG Motor India: Preparing a 2027 facelift for the MG Windsor featuring a larger 61 kWh battery to counter intensifying EV market pressure .
  • TVS Motor Company (TVSMOTOR): Discontinued the TVS Jupiter Special Edition in black 19.

Results & scores

  • IND vs NZ, 1st Test: Match drawn after New Zealand batted out 120 overs to finish at 239/5, denying India victory; Henry Nicholls earned Player of the Match for his unbeaten 175, after India had earlier declared their first innings at a mammoth 720/9 103.
  • Asia Cup Rising Stars: Pakistan A defeated India A by 48 runs, defending a total of 313 despite a century by Tilak Varma and a quickfire 70 from Abhishek Sharma .
  • Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Madhya Pradesh defeated Maharashtra by five runs after posting 208/9, backed by Akshat Raghuwanshi's rapid fifty, alongside comprehensive wins for teams like Tamil Nadu, Mumbai, and Baroda .

The big stories

  • Gill demands saliva ban reversal: Indian captain Shubman Gill urged the ICC to reconsider the ban on using saliva to shine the ball, stating that Kookaburra balls are softening too quickly 97.
  • Ganguly questions selection strategy: Former India captain Sourav Ganguly criticized the team management's bowling strategy in Wellington, questioning the omission of a specialist spinner like Kuldeep Yadav 10695.
  • Explaining Siraj's omission: Shubman Gill defended the tough decision to drop fast bowler Mohammed Siraj from the first Test lineup based on current form .
  • Jacks ruled out of Australia tour: England all-rounder Will Jacks suffered a broken right hand during the opening T20I in Melbourne and will miss the remainder of the series .
  • IPL & WPL squad updates: Ahead of upcoming auctions and tournaments, franchise retention lists continue to emerge, with Punjab Kings retaining 19 players and discussions growing around MS Dhoni's new non-playing role with CSK .

Coming up
